workload_selection: predefined first trace in each short class and first two SPEC2006-derived long IDs; six fixed traces, program identities for anonymized IDs not inferred
warmup_stability_rule: same ROI for all warmups; compare 200k vs 400k clean MPKI: absolute difference <= max(0.1,0.05*MPKI_400k). Record prediction disagreements separately, do not call state convergence. If not met, report sensitivity and do not silently label stability PASS
holdout_policy: separate file: warmup starts at original ordinal 800000, measurement at 1200000; design ends before 620000. Holdout correctness/data availability only, no prediction/performance evaluation before scope freeze
seed_rule: base + workload_index*1000000 + field_index*10000 + trial; independent time/K/location mt19937_64 seeds s,s+1,s+2
time_sampling: uniform ordinal in [0,20000) before conditional prediction; exactly one event, same 100k post-event branches for every trial
location_sampling: uniform valid K-bit consecutive logical-ID anchor within field; inactive rows included; K1 uniform per field bit
replay_schedule: upstream plain TAGE non-spec actual update, all control branches retained
instruction_denominator: inclusive original CBP record interval from injected conditional instruction through the Hth following conditional inclusive
primary_estimand: workload-stratified mean net extra misses and delta MPKI over the fixed post-event conditional horizon
scope_selection_model: M0 only; CHARM is separate sensitivity, never pooled as if joint measurements
scope_selection_rule: top two fields by B_field/65370 times equal-workload mean paired delta MPKI; no sample or mean clamping. Freeze best design estimates and disclose bootstrap rank uncertainty and whether scores are positive; no winner significance claim from overlapping intervals
scope_selection_secondary: per-event harm/help/net, tail/remaining-state and raw-direction/path/index-fold/tag-fold subfield diagnostics; report changes relative to bit-weighted ranking
statistical_unit: event trial resampled within each workload/field; no branch-level bootstrap; descriptive uncertainty conditional on six fixed design traces
binary_CI: Wilson 95% with worst-case n=100 half-width about 9.8pp; not a mean-loss precision guarantee
primary_trial_count_rule: fixed n, no precision-driven optional stopping after viewing main outcomes
resource_authority: user states no server limits; 4 workers are a bounded engineering choice, not all 64 CPUs
main_gate: source/E0 and new runner deterministic/equal-followup correctness PASS; <=100-trial speed calibration before main; dataset windows must be complete
censoring: last divergence is not recovery; endpoint logical/control equality is observed equality only, circular-buffer slack not physical exposure; residual difference at horizon remains censored
